lines.trans: Attention, everyone remain in your places!
The FSB special group is operating, drop weapons!
Calmly, major, regional police are operating here.
Who is your chief commander here?
Major General of Police Viktor Stepanovich is speaking.
We are conducting a secret operation here.
You must not act without my knowledge.
We have been catching dangerous corrupt officials for six months.
Let us calmly resolve this complex problem.
Do you have specific proposals?
This will be our shared joint operation.
Good, we are documenting the arrest together.

Prefix 'об-' ('around, about') marks encirclement or comprehensive action (stem 'ластной'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('regional, provincial').

examples.text: Девочка уже две недели лежит в областной клинике!
examples.trans: The girl has been lying in the regional clinic for two weeks already!
He went to the regional capital.

examples.text: Наверное, что-то серьёзное у вас. Девочка уже две недели лежит в областной клинике!
examples.trans: It must be something serious for you. The girl has been lying in the regional clinic for two weeks already!

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'екретный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('secret').

examples.text: А почему он на секретном совещании?

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'ложный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('complicated, difficult').
